name: novel-scenes
description: Compile chapter briefs into causal, stateful, cross-linked scene plans.
procedure: Order scenes by causal dependency rather than topic or spectacle.
Declare entry state, POV goal, obstacle, stakes, conflict, turn, outcome, revelation, and exit state.
Cross-link characters, threads, timeline, and setup/payoff keys before persisting plans.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
